o.text: From Proto-Turkic *būč-gak, from Proto-Turkic *būč- or Proto-Turkic *bïč-. Cognate with Turkish bucak, Chuvash пӗҫмех (pĕśmeh).
Compound of dəyər (“it is worth it”) + dəyməz (“it is not worth it”) + -i + -nə.
